tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos spyod lam khyer rim pa bzhugs so/ /

chos spyod lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ / mdzad pa'i phrin las gdul bya'i dbyings khyab pas/ /phan bde'i char rgyun 'gro la bsil mdzad pa/ /mchog gsum bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /theg pa'i 'jug sgo shin tu mtha' yas kyang*/ /chos kyi rtsa ba nyams len nyid la thug /de phyir nyin mtshan chos spyod bzang po'i khrigs/ /skal bzang thar pa 'dod rnams don du spro/ /de la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i skal ldan rnams kyis tho rangs dang*/ snga dro dang*/ phyi dro dang*/ srod dang*/ de dag gi thun bar rnams su ji ltar bya ba'i chos spyod kyi rim pa la/ tho rangs kyi dang po ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos sku stong pa'i ngang las gzugs sku sgyu ma'i rol pa rang byung tsam las/ snang ba thams cad bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams ye shes lnga'i rang 'od kyi klong na dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams ḍa ma ru dang rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa'o/ /'gag pa med pa'o/ /'ong ba med pa'o/ /'gro ba med pa'o/ /dmigs pa med pa'o/ /gnas pa med pa'o/ /mtshan ma med pa'o/ /bsam brjod med pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i don dran par byas la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo de ba bh+yaḥ na mo ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod la rmi lam sgyu ma tsam gyis ldang ngo*/ / de nas tho rangs kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje/ de thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams dang*/

/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ ma nam mkha' dngamanyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun = lan gsum gyis 'og tu/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= bla ma ci yang sprul pa'i sku la= bla ma mngon par byang chub sku la= bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku+u la= drin rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o/ /las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gang mos la 'jug cing*/ khyad par du/ chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod nas/ sems bskyed pa ni/ e ma ho/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dha rma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad mnyam pa chen po'i tshul rdo rje'i dbyings su gdod ma nas skye ba med pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang nas/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i mdzod spur 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du āḥ dmar po/

snying gar 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du hūṃ mth-ing ga /spyi bor pad+ma rin po che'i khri nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bi ma la mi tra dang*/ o rgyan pad+ma dang*/ kun tu bzang po la sogs pa brgyud pa' ི bla ma rnams dang yi dam mkha' 'gro dkon mchog gsum dang tha mi dad par dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa bar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas 'og min dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ 'ja' dang 'od kyi dkyil na so so'i gtso 'khor dang bcas te byon pa thams cad spyi gtsug gi lha dang gnyis su med par thim nas bzhugs pa la/ yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams byas pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag /bdud rtsis rkang mthil nas spyi gtsug gi bar khengs pas sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ /dbang bzhi thob/ gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i don mngon du gyur nas lta dgongs dang ting 'dzin rnam par dag pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang mos phul la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob mdzad pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /nges pa'i don du sems bskyed nas/ /'gro la phan phyir bla ma bsgom/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas/ / gsal drag bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas/ /thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol/ /'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ /sku dang thi ler shigs si shig /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/

bdag dang 'gyur med brtan par bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsum thugs kyi nyams chag bshags/ / smin grol dbang dang gdams pa zhu/ /oṃ/ sku skye 'chi med pa gsal la dwangs/ /rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus la bde ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /āḥ gsung 'gag pa med pa chos kyi sgra/ /ā li kā li la gsol ba 'debs/ /dag la nus pa 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /hūṃ/ thugs ka dag chen po kun bzang klong*/ /cir mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i rjes la/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i lam mkhan chen po ste/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ /mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /nyon mongs me yis gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mdzod/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzang po der/ /bdag ni yang dag gzhug tu gsol/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /gdos bcas lus kyis bcings pa la/ /rnam smin phung po'i rgyud dag nas/ /'od gsal dri med lus thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal ba thog med nas/ /brjod pa ngag gis bcings ba la/ /smra rgyu'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ /brjod med chos nyid ngag thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ 'khrul rtog sems kyis bcings pa la/ /'phro 'du'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ /mi rtog ye shes thugs thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /bya byed 'khrul pas bcings pa la/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ /byar med gnas lugs don thob mdzod/

/bdag ni bskal ba thog med nas/ /tha mal snang bas bcings pa la/ /dbang bzhi'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal ba thog med nas/ /snod bcud 'khrul pas bcings pa la/ /bskyed rdzogs zhen par rang dag nas/ /snang bzhi'i mthar phyin don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ / 'bad rtsol dmigs pas bcings pa la/ /rgyu 'bras zhen pa rang dag nas/ / lhun grub rang chas don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ / yin min mthar 'dzin bcings pa la/ lta sgom zhen pa rang dag nas/ /ka dag chos zad don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ yod med sgro skur bcings pa la/ grub mtha'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ mtha' bral snying po'i don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /dmigs myong 'dzin pa'i bcings pa la/ /nyams rtogs zhen pa rang dag nas/ /chos zad gdod ma'i don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul bas bcings pa la/ /chags sdang zhen pa rang dag nas/ /cis kyang dgos med don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /le lo rtag 'dzin bcings pa la/ /snyom las zhen pa rang dag nas/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzis bcings pa la/ /'khrul snang zhen pa rang dag nas/ 'chi ba rjes dran don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /bar do'i 'khrul pas bcing pa la/ /skye gnyis zhen pa rang dag nas/ /chos nyid 'od gsal don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal ba thog med nas/ /'gro drug skye bas bcings pa la/ /gzung 'dzin zhen pa rang dag nas/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal ba thog med nas/ /rnam dpyod dus kyis bcings pa la/ /soso'i 'bad rtsol rang dag nas/ /rang byung ye shes don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /rkyen ngan bar chad bcings pa la/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib rang dag nas/

/bde chen ye shes don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /rang rgyud chos kyis bcings pa la/ /chos brgyad zhen pa rang dag nas/ /chos zad blo 'das don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /don med bya bas bcings pa la/ /'bad rtsol zhen pa rang dag nas/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ khams gsum 'khor bas bcas bcings pa la/ /bag chags zhen pa rang dag nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /theg dman 'dzin pas bcings pa la/ /rang don zhen pa rang dag nas/ /gzhan don mthar yas don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /gzhi lam 'bras bus bcings pa la/ /theg dgu'i zhen pa rang dag nas/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i don thob mdzod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /gang dang gang gis bcings pa rnams/ /spang blang zhen pa rang dag nas/ /chos sku kun bzang don thob mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dus gcig la dag nas/ dbang dang byin rlabs dus gcig la thob ste/ rang babs rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la bla ma'i thugs dgongs dang dbyer med par sems khong glod la bzhag go /gal te bla ma dang mched la bsten pa'i dam tshig nyams chag gang zhig yod na de nyid spyi bor bsgoms la/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la 'gyod sems 'chi ma 'khrug pa tsam du bskyed la/ kye kye bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /mgon med bdag gi skyabs mdzad la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas/ /ma rig 'thibs po'i bdud kyis non/ /mgon po khyed dang khyed kyi sras/ /rdo rje spun la sogs pa la/ /brnyas shi ma dad sems la sogs/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag dang*/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba kun/ /gnong 'gyod chen pos dus 'dir bshags/ /skad cig nyid la byang bar mdzod/

/kye ma 'khor ba thog med nas/ /ma 'tshal bzhin du sdig bgyis pas/ /sngar yang 'khor bar rab tu 'khyams/ da yang 'khyams par 'gyur ba la/ /skyabs dang skyob pa mdzad du gsol/ /'di ltar mi shes byis pa la/ /skyon gyur mthong tshe lhag par yang*/ /thugs rjes gzigs la 'jug par rigs/ /'di ltar 'jig rten phal pa yang*/ /bu yis nyes pa gang bgyis pa/ pha yis sel zhing skyong la gzigs/ /thugs rje mnga' ba 'gro ba'i yab/ /bdag cag 'gro drug sems can gyi/ /don du dang po thugs bskyed nas/ /phan par mdzad ces dam bcas na/ /dus 'dir sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /bdag cag 'khrul pa'i sems can la/ /dgongs nas thugs rjes mi 'dzin na/ khyed kyi phrin las gdul bya la/ /phan zhes grags pa ji ltar rung*/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba grangs med kyang*/ /bdag cag spangs nas thar par gshegs/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang*/ /gcig pur zhi la rab tu gzhol/ khyod kyang de ltar gshegs mdzad dam/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ khyed la bskul nas bdag cag gi /don du bla mar rnam sprul na/ /khyod kyis bdag cag 'dor phod dam/ /'jigs ser skyel mas bslus pa bzhin/ khyod kyis bdag cag bslu mdzad dam/ /de lta na yang rang gi las/ /rnam par smin ces dgongs mdzad na/ /las dang bral ba de dag la/ /thugs rjes dgongs kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /sha za rnams kyang mchod sbyin dang*/ /bden pa'i tshig ni brjod ma thag /sngon gyi khro ba 'dor bgyid na/ khyod ni brtse chen 'gro ba'i yab/ /nyes pa bshags pa cis mi dgongs/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen kyang*/ /gsol ba btab nas dgos rgu sbyin/ khyed ni brtse chen thabs la mkhas/ /ci slad re ba skong mi mdzad/ /kye ma mgon po thugs rje can/ / bdag ni sdig kun ma byang bar/ /skye ba gzhan du song gyur na/ /dmyal me bzod dkas yun ring bsreg /de ltar gyur kyang mi skyob na/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid ji ltar lags/

/kye ma kyi hud bdag gi sdig /ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol/ /skad cig nyid la thugs rjes dgongs/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba dang*/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa dang*/ /'chi khar gnad gcod med pa dang*/ /bar do'i 'od gsal 'byongs pa dang*/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid pa mdzod/ /ces gdung ba'i gsol ba btab pas bdag gi nyams chag bskangs nas shin tu dgyes par bsam mo/ /'di ni 'gal 'khrul dang 'gyod tshangs spyod pa'i rgyal po ste/ /nyin mtshan du nyams su blangs pas de ma thag tu sgrib pa byang ba'i rtags 'byung bar nges so/ /de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung ba zhig dbyangs su btangs pa'i rjes la dar cig lus sems khong glod de/ rang bzhin babs kyi bsam gtan la dar cig mnyam par bzhag nas/ na mo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs khyod rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ sbyin pa'i dngos grub/ 'phags pa'i bden tshig la sogs pa dpag tu med pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag cag gis thar pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bdud dang bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing*/ lta ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ spyod pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor du bya ba'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel te myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ tshe 'di nyid du'ang nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la rkyen phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang gnod pa thams cad mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ /bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang*/ gnas dang*/ gos dang*/ longs spyod la sogs pa gang gis kyang 'brel ba dang phongs pa med cing bdog pa thams cad kyis bla ma dang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams mchod pa la yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams 'du zhing dngos grub thams cad char bzhin du 'bab pas/ 'dod rgu'i re ba thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'du bas phrin las rnam pa bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don mngon du gyur nas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi bya ba dang*/ brjod pa dang*/ sems pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad chos nyid kyi rol par shar te/ rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang*/ thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes dang*/ chu bo lta bu spobs pa dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i tshe dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ dpag tu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang*/ zad mi shes pa'i chos kyi mdzod dam pa la dbang bsgyur bar mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bla na med pa mngon du gyur nas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor du sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings la snang ba bzhi'i don mthar phyin te/ skye ba dang 'jug pa la rang dbang thob nas/ 'pho ba chen po'i lus 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar ma gyur gyi bar du yang tshe 'di'i rnam par g.yeng ba dang 'jig rten chos brgyad la sogs pa tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i phyogs su skad cig tsam yang mi 'brang zhing*/ bslab pa gsum dang mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin pas bla ma dam pa rnams mnyes par byed cing zab pa rgya che ba'i chos kyi de kho na nyid rtogs nas sgrub pa nan tan snying por byas te/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob nas nyin mtshan rtag tu chos kyis 'da' zhing*/ bsdu ba bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa la skyo ngal dang phyogs ris med par mdzad du gsol/ 'chi khar yang gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dang*/

rkyen ngan pa'i mtshams sbyor ba med cing zab mo'i don mngon du gyur nas dga' ba dang bcas/ spro ba dang bcas pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsus nas gdod ma'i dbyings su khrid cing ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas pas 'gro ba thams cad yongs su 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ bar dor yang chos nyid kyi don mngon du gyur nas srid pa bar do'i g.yang sa mi mthong zhing*/ lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs la brtan pa mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol lo/ /gal te snang ba'i spyod yul gzhan du gyur na yang*/ 'gro drug 'khrul pa'i mngal sgo bcad de/ rang bzhin sprul pa sku'i zhing khams bgrod nas thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang dbye ba med pa'i sa la lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ dgongs sbyong rgya mtsho gdeng du ma gyur pas srid pa gzhan du phyogs par gyur na yang*/ mtho ris kyi yon tan khyad par can gyi lus thob nas skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad do/ /tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rang dbang 'byor pas bla ma dam pa rnams mnyes par byed cing*/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po yongs su 'dzin pas/ chos kyi phung po mtha' dag rjes su slob cing*/ sgrub pa la nan tan snying por byed pas bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi thob ste/ gsang sngags kyi dam pa de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub brnyes nas/ tshe 'dir kun tu bzang po byang chub mchog gi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ /

zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ / de nas tho rangs kyi thun dngos gzhi la thabs kyi rig pa gcun la rdzogs pa chen po'i don la mnyam par bzhag nas/ rjes la spyi gtsug gi bla ma rang la thim ste/ bdag dang bla ma dbyer med kyi ngang la dar cig bzhag / des ni lta dgongs dang byin rlabs dngos su 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /yang bla ma steng gi nam mkhar bsams la/ rang nyid 'od lnga'i gong bur 'bar ba yang 'phar/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas je mthor song ba las rang yal te ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i rang la dar cig bzhag go /des ni rig pa'i dwangs thon nas chos skur ngang mal du+u gnas/ 'pho ba'i lam byang nas bar ngo g.yang sa chod/ lus rgya grol ba dang rnam par grol ba dus mnyam du byed de/ de nas/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te/ srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas par/ /thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /nyin dang mtshan mo chos la spyod par shog /bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhi dga' ba der/ /pad+ma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ / dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam 'grub par shog /ces bsngos la/ /chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes pas stan las langs par bya'o/

/tshul 'di lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba byin rlabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las tho rangs kyi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas snga gong gi rnal 'byor ni/ /nam gyi mtha' btegs pa dang yi ge brgya pa'i chus khrus byas te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi drung du dngos sam yid kyi/ /mchod pa bshams la/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul pa rnams kyis yan lag ma lnga sa la btud pa'i tshul gyis/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed do/ / 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'dir ru/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ d+dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūṃ/ na mo/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i gsung*/ /'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs rigs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha'i thugs/ /bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa dag /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*/

/bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen gnyis sku gsum grub/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' cir yang sa ler mkhyen/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan/ /sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang*/ /chos la skye 'gag med cing spros las dben/ /de la dmigs te yon tan kun 'grub pa/ /legs bsgyur dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par gsal nas sangs rgyas sar/ /sems can don mdzad sangs rgyas zhing sbyong ba/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po zhi dang nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs bcu'i ting 'dzin ye shes mche ba can/ /gang gis skye ba'i rang bzhin gzeb bral nas/ /mya ngan 'das shing 'brog dgon bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /ston pa glang po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/

/gser mdog 'dra ba khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ /mnyam med mkhyen can khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sems bskyed dam pa rin po che/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba/ /mgon po mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*/ /shākya thub pa go'u tam lha yi lha/ / sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grags chen shes rab chen po pa/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po ste/ /srid pa'i nyon mongs brgal ba po/ /nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi bral ba yi dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs mdzad khyed phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i tshogs mnga' zhing*/ /mtshan rab ye shes yongs su dag pa'i sku/ /gser gyi mdog can lha dang mis mchod pa/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di la goms pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing khams thams cad gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rin chen rnam pa mang po gcal du bkram/ /me tog puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /yum gyur dge ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid bco brgyad chos kyi sdong po la/ /pha rol phyin drug yal 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas/

/skye 'gag med pa'i 'bras bu so sor smin/ /sa bcu chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab tu brgyan/ /'jig rtenagasum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*/ /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa yi snying po byams pa spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha'i snying po kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang sgrib pa sel ba ste/ /sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun bzang yab yum zhi khro rab 'byams dang*/ /dga' rab rdo rje paṇa chen bi ma la/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /'od gsal bstan 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ti l+li nā ro dang*/ /bram ze sa ra ha dang lū hi pa/ /in+da bh+ru ti sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ /ḍom+bi he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dril bu pad+ma badz+ra dang*/ /bir+wa ba pa dang nag po spyod pa dang*/ /ku ku ri pa grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /bcu phrag brgyad po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de ba dang*/ /thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od la sogs/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shā ri'i bu dang mo 'u 'gal gyi bu/ /kun dga' bo dang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ /ma 'gag pa dang 'od srung rab 'byor te/ /nyan thos mchog brgyad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i don du tshul bzhin bsgyur dang spel/ /sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba cher mdzad pa'i/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar ba'i rjes la gdan la 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas/ / thun mong gi nyes ltung bshags pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol lo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar ba'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /me sbed do/ /de ltar mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/

oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes yi ge brgya ba bzla'o/ /de nas gdan la 'dug ste/ mdun gyi nam mkha' rtsa ba gsum dang dkon mchog gsum bsams la/ dang por thun mong gi sems bskyed ni/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'grau la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol par bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod nas/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ e ma ho/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ maṇ+ḍa' rgyas bsdus gang mos phul te/ tshig don dang ldan pas/ oṃ/ gdod ma'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub nas/ /'khor 'das kun gyi thog ma'i mgon po mchog /kun bzang rigs lnga zhi khro srung mar bcas/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /yon tan 'bar ba'i dbyings su lhun rdzogs te/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar nyid du/ /srid 'gro nyam ngar yun ring 'khor ba na/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ / 'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'phags gnyis so so'i skye bo ma lus pa'i/ /dus gsum dge ba bgyis dang bgyid stsal dang*/ /bgyis par gyur pa kun la yi rang ngo*/ /glo bur nyon mongs dang ldan sems can

rnams/ khams de'i rang bzhin dag pa mthong bya'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rmad byung bskor du gsol/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten nyi ma gang du byon/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur sras dang bcas pa kun/ /srid pa'i mun nag thibs po bsal slad du/ /'khor ba ji srid sgron me mdzad par gsol/ /yon tan dge 'os rgyal ba'i byang chub mchog /skye rgu kun gyis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /bsod nams phung po yongs su bsngo bgyis pas/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /hoḥ rdzogs sangs rin chen dag pa'i sems nyid dang*/ /rtog pa'i dri ma rab bral dam pa'i chos/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*/ /sred dang bral ba rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /deng nas bdag ni 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i phyir/ /mgon rnams 'bangs su bdag nyid 'bul lags kyi/ /brtse ba'i thugs rjes bzhes par mdzad du gsol/ /byams pa'i zhal bzang dus 'dir gzigs nas kyang*/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad bskang du gsol/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes mthar phyin pa'i/ /lha yi lha khyod bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa rgya mtsho dang*/ /lha dang lha min sngags 'chang dam tshig can/ /kun nas 'dus pa rnams kyang dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rgyal srid mtho ris longs spyod dang*/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsgrub pa ma lags te/ /'gro la snying brtse kho na'i don brtson pas/ /srid pa gsum gyi gnyen gyur gcig tu 'tshal/ /'di la kun mkhyen khyod nyid dbang du gsol/ /mgon po ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*/ /khyod kyis bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen/ /'phags pa'i spyan sngar bdag gis dam bca' ba/ /nyams par mi 'gyid mgon khyod bslu ma lags/ /deng nas bdag gis khe dang grags la sogs/ /g.yo dang zang zing sems ni gtan spangs nas/ /gzhan don sgrub pa gcig pu'i sems bzhag ste/
/rnal 'byor spyod pa chen po bdag gis spyad/ /kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi/

/ byang chub mchog tu bdag gis sems bskyed de// don dam dang ni kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /deng nas tshul bzhin yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /srog chags thams cad gal te 'dud gyur nas/ /dum bu stong du bdag gi lus gtub kyang*/ /byang chub sems mchog shes rab snying rje dang*/ /yi dam rgyal ba khyod ni yong mi gtong/ /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho bzung ba ltar/ /deng nas bdag kyang lam chen der zhugs te/ /'gro la phan phyir de dag bzung bar bgyi/ /gdod nas ma skyes mkha' ltar rnam dag cing*/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub rang byung 'od gsal ba/ /ji bzhin ma bcos chos nyid don bsgoms te/ /chos sku yangs pa chen po'i mkha' dbyings su/ /kun bzang don gyi rang zhal bzung bar bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed cing*/ /byang chub snying po rang la mtshon pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i rdzas kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /rang bzhin bskyed rdzogs don las mi 'da' zhing*/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu bkur ba dang*/ /thabs dang shes rab rang la mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu'i rdzas kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /bsam 'phel rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /sbyin pa rnams bzhis 'gro kun skyong ba dang*/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs byed cing*/ /lhun grub yon tan rang la mtshon pa'i phyir/ /nor bu rin chen rdzas kyang bzung par bgyi/ /ma chags pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i chos rnams yongs bzung zhing*/ /'gro la tshad med snying rjes chags pa dang*/ /skyon bral chos nyid rang la mtshan pa'i phyir/ /yid 'ong pad+ma mchog kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /sna tshogs las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/

/ theg gsum sdom pa mtha' yas bzung ba dang*/ /don gnyis lhun grub rang la mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rgya gram ral gri mchog kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig tu/ /zung 'jug lam du thams cad blang ba dang*/ /spang blang med pa'i rol pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa cang te'u bzung bar bgyi/ /mdor na gang gis 'khor ba rnams spyod pa/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams dag byed cing*/ /dbang po yul dang nyon mongs rnam spyod pa/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang gsung lnga dang*/ /yon tan phrin las rigs lnga sgrub pa'i rdzas/ / phyi rol dam rdzas 'dod yon thabs chen la/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa dang*/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig lnga rnams la/ /rdo rje mchog sgrub sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ /shes dang mi spang dang du blang ba dang*/ /bsgrub dang sbyang par bya ba lnga lnga ste/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad rtsa ba yan lag bcas/ /gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i sdom pa kun/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag gis bzung bar bgyi/ /gang la brten nas srid pa rnam sbyong zhing*/ /zhi ba thar pa dam pa'i lha chos kun/ /'gro ba'i don du bdag gis yongs su bzung*/ /srid zhi mi gnas byang chub mchog zhugs te/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun mchod pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis brtson pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho bsgrub/ /'gro la snying brtse phan pa mchog tu bya/ /gnod pa mi bya brnyas par yongs mi bgyid/ /gcig pur zhi ba don du mi gnyer zhing*/ /gzhan don yang dag sgrub la brtson pa yis/ /rang gzhan thar pa'i sgo ni dbye bar bgyi/ hoḥ mtha' yas theg pa chen po'i lam mchog tu/ /ma lus 'gro kunabadag gis yongs drangs te/ /thams cad byang chub mchog la rab bkod nas/ /kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i sa thob shog /thar lam byang chub snying por bdag zhugs nas/ /ji srid bla med byang chub mchis kyi bar/

/ tshe rabs gang du skye ba de dang der/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje mchog gyur bla ma la gus shing*/ /'gro ba'i don rnams sgrub la mkhas pa dang*/ /dpal mgon bla ma rab tu mnyes byed shog /deng nas byang chub snying por mchis bar du/ /bcom ldan rdo rje kun tu bzang po dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor srung ma dam tshig can/ /bka' gsang rmad byung bla na med pa dang*/ /rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /g.yar dam gcig pas gtan du 'grogs par shog /sgrub mchog 'di la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas thar lam mthar phyin nas/ /bskyed rdzogs grub pas rig 'dzin gral 'khod de/ /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub thob par shog /bcom ldan kun bzang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /sa ler mtho nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ /blta bar 'dod dang 'dri bar 'dod na yang*/ / sgrib med mgon po mngon sum mthong bar shog /gang tshe bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub spyod pa na/ /dgongs spyod ting 'dzin rgya mtsho mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje mchog gsum grub pas phrin las bzhi/ /brtsams pa tsam gyis mngon du 'gyur bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam zhing rnams kyi/ / sems can ma lus byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir/ /kun bzang spyod pa ci 'dra bdag gyur te/ /rgyal sras byang chub spyod pa mtha' yas shog /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag dge sems can rnams la yongs smin te/ /'gro kun bde gshegs byang chub mchog thob nas/ /gzhan don spyod pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /bdag gi brtson pas mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /srid las rnam grol 'khor ba stong pa na/ /bdag kyang byang chub dam pa nyid thob nas/ /chos sku kun tu bzang dang dbyer med shog /tshe rabs kun tu 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur te/ /skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med pa yi/ /sems can don du 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pas/

/nor bu rin chen mchog dang mtshungs par shog /dbang bcu mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*/ /gzungs dang rnam thar yon tan mchog grub nas/ /gzhan gyis ma thul 'gro rnams 'dul ba dang*/ /thams cad byang chub mchog tu 'god par shog /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyur ba'i 'gro ba la/ /dam chos rin chen bdud rtsi'i char phab nas/ /chos dang mi 'jigs zang zing sbyin pa yis/ /skye rgu thams cad bde la 'god par shog /gsang sngags rgyal po bla med mchog grub nas/ /mtha' yas zhing du rnam sprul rgya mtsho dang*/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro bas/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas rnams bgrod pa dang*/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing rnams blta ba dang*/ /dur khrod brgyad dang tshan+dho la sogs pa/ / mkha' 'gro rnams dang dgongs pa mnyam par shog /mngon shes mang pos gdul bya'i rgyud mkhyen te/ /ting 'dzin mang pos ye shes lus grub nas/ / rig sngags mang pos gsang sngags dngos grub brnyes/ /sa mchog mang po'i dkyil 'khor 'grub par shog /'gro blo'i rim pa ji bzhin dbang po'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i chos kyi char bsil bas/ /gnas skabs so so'i re ba yongs bskangs nas/ /mthar thug theg pa'i rgyal por 'jug par shog /mkha' khyab yon tan yid bzhin sprin tshogs las/ /dngos grub rnam pa mang po'i char 'bebs shing*/ /gang la ci 'dul de la der snang bas/ / mtha' yas sems can smin pa'i mthu ldan shog /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs dpag med kyis/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung thogs nas mdun bsus te/ /'og min mkha' spyod gnas su phyin par shog /skad cig de la chos sku mthar phyin te/ /gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag po ru/ /rdo rje bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /gzhon nu bum pa sku yi zhing khams su/

/ rin chen sbubs la brtan pa mthar phyin te/ /gzugs sku'i rol pas gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/ /sprul pa rnam pa mang po 'gyed par shog /ye shes chos kyi sku dang dbyer med cing*/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i mkha' dbyings su/ /ma 'bad bzhin du ngang gis phyin par shog /rang bzhin 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rig rdo rje sems dpa'i don mthonganas/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i phrin las rlabs chen gyis/ /'gro kun phyam gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog /gser gyi nyi ma rnams ni klong du thim/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer nye bar zhi ba na/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po dri med mchog gi yul/ /rnam dag yangs pa chen po'i don mthong shog /dbang bzhis smin pa'i rig pa byang chub sems/ /'od gsal snang ba bzhi po mngon gyur nas/ /gdos bcas phung po 'od kyi skur grol te/ /'pho ba chen pos gzhan don 'grub par shog /'ching byed lus kyi rgya las ma grol bar/ /gang zhig 'chi 'pho gnad gcod sdug bsngal med/ /bar do'i 'od gsal gdams pa mngon gyur nas/ /lhun grub sa la gtan srid zin par shog /gang zhig srid pa par do mthong na yang*/ /skad cig de la rang snang 'jigs bral nas/ /mngon dga' la sogs dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ / mngon par byang chub mdzad pa mtha' yas shog /sa mchog 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse mo ru/ /bdag cag rdo rje rnal 'byor zhugs so 'tshal/ /bar chad med lam brtan pa mthar phyin nas/ /kun bzang che mchog he ru ka thob shog / chos dbyings rnam dag rnam snang bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang phyug chen po lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /stug po'i rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyis brgyan/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /me long rnam dag mi bskyod bcom ldan 'das/ /grags pa mthar phyin lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mngon dga'i rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyis brgyan/

/rdo rje rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /mnyam nyid rnam dag rin chen bcom ldan 'das/ /yon tan mthar phyin lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /dpal ldan rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyis brgyan/ /rin chen rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /kun rtog rnam dag dpag med bcom ldan 'das/ /bde chen dbang phyug lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /bde ldan rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyi brgyan/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /bya grub rnam dag don grub bcom ldan 'das/ /phrin las mthar phyin lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /las rab rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyis brgyan/ /las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /rang rig rnam dag kun bzang bcom ldan 'das/ / 'khor 'das kun gyi lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /gdod ma'i rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyis brgyan/ /thams cad lhun grub dngos grub thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /'di ni dang po dbang mnos pa'i sdom pa bzung ba ste/ shin tu gal che bas nan tan du bya'o/ / de nas nyi ma 'char ka la sogs pa'i tshe zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /thun mong du dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pas bza' ba ni/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas rab tu brgyan pa/ bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/ mtshan rnams kyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi non pa/ stobs rnams la brdzi ba med pa/

sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ /gzugs dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/ gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ sdug bsngal dag las rnam par grol ba/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/ khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams bcad pa/ yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ sred pa las yongs su grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod par bstan pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la legs par bstan pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang bcas pa/ rten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni/ legs par zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa 'di lta ste/ skyes bu zung bzhi dang gang zag ya brgyad po dag yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni/ tshangs par spyod pa kun gyis sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/

rab tu sbyin par 'os pa/ bskong ba bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing*/ yon sbyong ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ bla na med pa yin no/ /theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun ni/ legs par zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i 'os su gyur/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing*/ yon yongs su byang ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun gyis sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin pas/ dus rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa legs par gyis shig /zas rnams swa bhā was stong par sbyangs nas/ yar dkon mchog la bshos phud/ mar yi dwags la chang bu ster ba sogs zhal las shes so/ khyad par du stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid kun tu bzang po yab yum mthing ga mnyam gzhag dang rdo rje'i skyil krung can nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs pa'i dung khang du khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor/ spyi bor bla ma/ mgrin par yi dam/ pho bar mkha' 'gro/ lte bar chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams bsams la/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bzang btung bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs la rol pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mchod pas dgyes te dngos grub thob par bsams la tshim par longs spyad nas/ he ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /ces dang*/ bsngo ba gzhan yang gang mos byas la/ mdo ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang*/

thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i spyod pa nyid la rnam par blta zhing*/ phung po lnga po de dag la'ang rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par blta'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bum mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu+u mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo spyod pa 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam blta bar bya ste/ phung po lnga po de dag la yang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang*/ /'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa rnams la stong pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gag pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o/ shā ri'i bu de bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed med/ rnam par shes pa med/ mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med/

gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med/ chos med do/ /mig gi khams med pa nas/ yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do/ /ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas/ rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang*/ kun 'byung ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam med/ ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med do/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' rnams thob pa med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la brten cing gnas te/ sems la sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med do/ /phyin ci logs las shin tu 'das nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ /dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo la brten cing gnas te/ sems la sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med do/ /phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ /dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i sngags/ rig pa chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi brdzun pa rnams bden par shes par bya ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swāhā/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/

legs so legs so rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyad par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //

tshogs la rol ba ni/ tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin du bstan pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gsar pa yin na swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ trām̐ las lha'i gos yid du 'ong bar bsams la/ bla ma bzhugs na phud phul ba'am/ phul ba'i mos pa bya/ mi bzhugs kyang phyogs der bsam pa dud nge ba byas nas phul bas bzhes te dgyes nas slar bdag la gnang bar bsams la/ lus lhar bskyed nas gyon pas gos kyi dngos grub thob bo/ /rtag tu gon pa'i rnying pa yin na lha'i gos su shes pas rang nyid lhar gsal ba tsam bya'o/ / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ snod bcud thams cad zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du gsal ba'i ngang nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba ci dang ci byed sprul pa tsam du bla ma'i bya ba byed par bsam pas bya byed thams cad dge bar 'gyur te/ lam gyi grogs su 'gyur zhing gang bsgrub kyang myur ba dang bar chad mi 'byung ba yin no/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las/ snga gong gi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas snga dro'i rnal 'byor ni/ phyogs dwangs shing nyams dga' bar 'dug ste/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don la snga ma bzhin mnyam par bzhag cing*/ mchog tu thod rgal gyi don la bslab par bya'o/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las/ snga dro'i rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas gung gi rnal 'byor ni/ nyi ma gung gi cha la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi drung ngam phyogs yid du 'ong bar/ nam mkha' la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs par bsams la/ /maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phyis pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag nas/ bh+rum̐ las sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dag pa/ gser gyi ri dang*/ gling dang*/ sa gzhi mdzes pa la/ 'dod pa dang gzugs khams kyi lha dang mi'i 'dod yon dpag tu med pa dang*/

gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' bde dang*/ zhing dag pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa la sogs pa dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dga' bde dpag tu med pas gang bar bsams la/ tshom bu lnga dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis bkod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sna tshogs khams chen sems can dbyings mtha'i ji srid ma lus kun khyab gzugs dang bkod pa dang dpag yas rgya mtsho'i snying po gang can mtshos brgyad lha mi'i bkod sprin nam mkha'i dbyings tsam de snying rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas mchod 'os rnams la gus pas 'bul/ gser gyi sa gzhir ri dbang lhun pos brgyan/ /gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla gza' skar dkram/ lha mi 'dod yon phun sum tshogs dang ldan pa/ /gli bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen chu mtsho me tog gis bkram rnam dag pad+ma'i gzhal yas chu dbang yid bzhin dbang pos nyer brten sa 'og sa steng sa bla bar snang la gnas khang brtsegs yid 'ong rnam mang lha yi skyed tshal 'od dang gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas mchod/ /gser dang dngul dang shel dang in+d+ra rnyil/ /ma rgad mu sa ga r+bha bai ḍūr+ya/ /yid bzhin nor bu sna tshogs mdzes 'bar ba/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing chen rnams kyis mchod/ /pad+ma ku mu ta dang ut+pal dri ldan mdangs bkra yid 'ong kha bye lhag ger gsal gyur nor bu'i gdu bu yid 'ong 'khrol bas mdzes byas lha mi'i bu mo bstod dbyangs sgrogs ldan gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dbyangs mtho ris sa steng dpal 'byor rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rnam pa brgyad/ /gzhal med khang mdzes yid 'ong nyams dga' ba/ /mi dbang dpal phreng phun tshogs 'di phul bas/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs lhun gyis grub gyur cig

/bsam gtan lha gnas shin tu nyams dga' dwangs pa'i 'od kyi gzhal yas khang bkram gzugs bzang lha mang gis mdzes bsam gtan zhi ba'i skyed mos tshal gcig mi g.yo gzugs dang gzugs med ye shes rol ba'i ting 'dzin la reg srid gsum dngos dang dngos med bde dga' rgya mtsho rnams kyis mchod/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ / rgyal ba'i gzungs sprin snying po las 'thon pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ dag pa'i zhing khams rgyal sras 'byor pas yongs gar lha mi'i bde 'byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dang bcas ye shes las grub gzhal yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab longs sku'i zhing gi dpal 'byor chos sku'i zhing gi snying po ma lus yongs bkod bde chen rgya mtshor 'gro kun phyam gcig bgrod par shog /rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/ /phun tshogs bsod nams zhing la phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /ces phul bas thun mong gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas zhing khams dag pa la spyod pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / de nas khyad par gyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas ye shes lnga'i zhing khams pa spyod par bya ba'i phyir/ /lnga tshan lnga ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod la/ zhing khams thams cad spos kyi dri dang*/ sman sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru sna dang*/ rin po che dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis gang bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin gyi drwa bas kun nas brgyan pa'i zhing khams/ gser gyi sa gzhi/ rin po che'i ri bo/ sman gyi nags tshal/ spos kyi sprin phung*/ 'bru'i bang mdzod/ me tog gi skyed mos tshal/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sogs pa/ lha dang mi'i mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas bar bkang ste/

bla ma dang yi dam dkyila'akhor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul lo/ /zhing khams thams cad gser gyi sa gzhi kun nas mdzes pa'i snying po la/ /rin chen sna tshogs sil mar bkram zhing yid 'ong nor bu'i 'od 'bar bas/ /mtha' dang dbus med nam mkha'i dbyings khyab dpag yas mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i rin chen sna tshogs kyis/ /namamakha' mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis/ /'gro kun gnas skabs dgos 'dod lhun grub cing*/ /mthar thug ye shes lnga la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad sna tshogs 'bru mang kun nas bkram pa'i sa gzhi la/ sman shing me tog lo tog rab rgyas dud pa'i 'bras bus rab tu phyug khang brtsegs 'bru mang 'byor pas yongs gang yid 'ong lha yi gzhal med khang*/ /bsam gtan ro brgya'i zas kyi rjes 'gro 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung dam pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'bru mang 'byor pa shin tu dpag yas kyis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis/ /'gro kun gnas skabs 'byor pa mtha' yas shing*/ mthar thug sku lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad dri gtsang gis khyab gser gyi sa gzhi bstar ba la/ /tsan+dan sna tshogs phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa bkod gyur cing*/ /spos kyi dpag bsam chu mtshos rab brgyan dri zhim dwangs pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'di/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis/ /'gro kun gnas skabs dbang po rab gsal zhing*/ /mthar thug kun bzang zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad sman gyi sa gzhi rab tu dwas pas brgyan pa la/

/sman gyi ri bo shin tu dpag med kun nas bkod pas mdzes par bkang*/ /bkra shis gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas nad kun zhi bar byed pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /sman mchog bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin dam pa 'di/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis/ /'gro kun gnas skabs tshe ring nad med cing*/ /mthar thug bde chen zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad rin chen sil mas kun nas bkang bar gyur pa la/ /pad+ma'i mtsho dang me tog khang brtsegs ut+pal drwa bas sbrel legs pa/ /dus bzhir lha yis me tog char 'beb sa dang bar snang brgyan pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs rin chen mdzes 'bar bas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun gnas skabs shes rab rgya che zhing*/ /mthar thug 'od lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog /ces 'bul lo/ /'dis ni tshe ring ba dang*/ /nad med pa dang*/ longs spyod dang ldan pa dang*/ snang ba bzhi'i ye shes gong du 'phel ba la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa gsungs so/ /rgyas par ni yang tig yid bzhin nor bur shes par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i snying gar pad zla'i dbus na rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad dag nas snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams su bsams la/ yi ge brgya ba ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar thams cad dmigs su med pa'i ngang la dar cig klod nas/ bsngo ba bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje ses dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod/ nyin zhag gi cha'i nyams chag bshags pa la 'di las zab pa med do/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las/

/snga gung gyi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas phyi dro'i rnal 'byor ni/ /phyi dro'i dus su yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin la snga ma ltar mnyam par bzhag go /phyi dro'i rnal 'byor ro/ / de nas dgong thun gyi rnal 'byor la/ /dang po gtor ma bya ba ni/ /thog mar rgyun gtor cha lnga bshams te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ na mo/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dha rma swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid thugs rje chen po dkar po g.yas pad+ma thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ du gyur pa las gtor ma la phog / ram̐ las mes ma dag pa thams cad bsreg kham̐ las chu byung bas sbyangs/ yam̐ las rlung byung bas gtor te/ stong ba'i ngang las keṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum tsam gyi nang du gtor ma so so'i ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ri rab dang rgya mtsho mnyam pas khengs/ yam̐ las rlung g.yos/ ram̐ las me 'bar bas thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol/ zla ba'i kha chod rdo rje rtse lnga pas brgyan pa lte ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgu thams cad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi zla pad+ma seng ge rin po che'i khri la sogs pa grangs med pa bsams la/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/

/sems 'di rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed do/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus la mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i rnams dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī lo ka pā sa sarba sa ma ya dzaḥ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams byon/ /dbus su bla ma/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ki nī lo ka pā la sarba badz+ra puṣ+pe/ bhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+yā/ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis mchod nas/ gtor ma dang po bla ma dang yi dam la phul bas dgyes nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ma hā gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pa liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid dpal ldan rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gro spyi la phul bas dgyes nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ karma ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya ḍā ki nī/ bi shā ḍā ki nī/ lo ka ḍā ki nī/ ha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hri ya/ tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dzaḥb liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo/ 'khor mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba ye shes dang las las grub pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gsum pa ni/ srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phul bas dgyes par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la shā sa na a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ trag rag+sha e ka dzā ṭi ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ rag+mo khyi kha la ba liṃ ta khā ti/ oṃ rā hul ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ rme ru rtse ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu ba liṃ ta khā he/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ma hā kā la 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du yang dpal ldan sngags kyi bdag mo/ shan pa srog sgrub nag mo/ /gza'i dge bsnyen rā hu+u ྄la/ gnod sbyin dmar nag /dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa bsrung ba dang*/ re ba thams cad bskang du gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ gter bdag rnams dang yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la phul bas dgyes pa bsams la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ād+ya nut+pa n+to ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ 'dzam bu gling dang kha ba can la gnas pa'i gter bdag chen po rnams dang yul lha gzhi bdag gi rigs su gyur pa dang*/ lha mthu bo che/ klu mthu bo che/ bdud mthu bo che/ btsan mthu bo che/ ma mo mthu bo che la sogs pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsam pa bsgrub cing re ba skong ba dang*/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig gnyan po bsrung zhing*/ bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa ni/ 'byung po la a kā ros phul te/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i 'byung po kun tu rgyu zhing phan gnod byed pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis/

ging chen bco brgyad/ laṅka'i bdag po mgrin bcu/ pho nya sum brgya drug cu/ mgyogs ma bzhi/ 'bar ma brgyad/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi la sogs pa rnal 'byor pa'i re ba bskang bar khas blangs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang klu dang sha za dang grib gnon la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing*/ chag che ba dang*/ nyam nga ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ hūm̐/ rnam dag chos nyid zhi ba las/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa 'byung*/ /thabs shes zla gsang thig le las/ /yal gam can rnams 'du bar mdzod/ /'du mdzad rnam dag 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la gtsang sar gshags so/ /de nas kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma cha bdun bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sa m+bha ra hūṃ/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha 'bar ma gzi brjid chen mos gtso byas yi dwags kyi rigs su gyur pa mkha' la rgyu ba/ bying na gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nad dang rims dang 'tshe ba thams cad mi 'byung ba mdzad du gsol/ de nas brgya rtsa ni/ oṃ ā ཿhūm̐ gis gtor ma 'dod yon gyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par byin gyis brlabs la/ lnga pa man chad nas de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan mthar brjod pa dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki ti'i sngags lan gsum gyis 'bul ba thams cad la 'dra bas/ dang po ni/ dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa/ dpal ma hā kā la la sogs pa srung ma dam tshig can thams cad la 'bul lo/

/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing 'khor rnams pa bzhi bskyang du gsol/ gsum pa ni/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhi sems can la phan bde 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ /bzhi pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa dang dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang lha dang mi'i drang srong chen po thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bdag gi bden pa'i tshig rnams 'grub nas legs pa thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa ni/ sam+ba ra'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ /klu chen po brgyad kyis gtso byams pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /sa bdag klu gnyan gyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ drug pa ni/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /gnas mgron gyi dam tshig la gnas pa dang*/ 'go zhing stong grogs gnyen po mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye ba rnams pa bzhi/ srid pa bar do'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /brgyad pa ni/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo gzi brjid che mos gtso byas pa'i yi dwags kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /dgu pa ni/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi na ya kas gtso byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu thams cad la 'bul lo/

/gnod sems dang gdug sems thams cad zhi nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /bcu pa ni/ lan chags kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bu lon dang lan chags thams cad 'khor nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /tha ma ni/ glo bur du lhags pa thams cad dang*/ khas nyen pa/ dbang chung ba/ lhag ma dang bshal chu+u la re ba thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bza' btung longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas chu sbyin ni/ gtor snod lnga'i dang po'i nang du chu sbreng pas yi dwags thams cad tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ swāhā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas te/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog / ces brjod do/ /gtor gcig ma ni/ gtor gzhong bar pa gsum du chu lan bdun bdun blug cing*/ oṃ dzā la mi daṃ sarba pre ta bh+yaḥswāhā/ yi dwags kyi tshogs gad+gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad ngoms shing tshim par gyur cig / ces brjod do/ /lhag gtor ni/ gtor gzhong tha mar zan 'bru dang chu blugs la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta piṇ+ḍa sarba pre te bh+yoḥs ma bh+yaḥswāhā/ lhag ma'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bza' btung longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de nas bden pa'i stobs dang chos kyi sbyin pa la sogs pa ni/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/

/rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa na/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge sbyong dag /sdug bsngal kun las nges grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ / ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang ste/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ / legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ /'gro ba'i nang du rang byung sangs rgyas shog / sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog /bdag cag yon mchoda'akhor dang bcas pa'i rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du grub ste myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig / sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bsngos shing smon lam ci btab 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ gzhan yang thugs rje chen po'i brul gtor la songs pa'i spyi gtor rnams spyi dang mthun par gang shes mdzad pas chog go

/gang zag gi rigs rnams mi gcig pas spros pa la dga' na de ltar mdzod/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hoḥ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu+u na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / 'phags pa khyadapar can khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ sbyin pa'i dngos grub/ 'phags pa'i bden tshig la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag chos sgrub pa po rnams kyis yang*/ /rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas/ /lta ba dang*/ dgongs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa chos spyod kyi rtogs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du 'phel te mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ /yul khams dang sa phyogs thams cad du'ang lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ char chu dus gsum 'bab pa dang*/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod dang mtha' dmag la sogs pa rkyen phyi nang gi gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du'ang yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ ye 'brogs sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ chag che ba dang nyam nga ba la sogs pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs pa mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ 'di dang phyi ma'i mngon par mtho ba dang*/ /nges par legs pa'i re smon dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa thams cad bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/

/zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum bsams la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad thal mo sbyar la skyabs su 'gro bar bsam la/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes gdangs snyan pos brgya rtsa gcig bzlas pas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum gyi sku las 'od 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar thams cad 'od du yal te/ ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par bzhag go /'di ni chos spyod thams cad kyi rtsa ba gal po che yin no/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba/ g.yon 'og mas pad dkar bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥl yi ge drug pas bskor ba/ g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa dkar ser g.yas nor bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon du sras mo rig sngags 'chang dmar ser g.yas phreng ba dang pad+ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis gus pas 'dud pa phyag rgya can/ zhabs phyed skyil zla ba dang pad+ma'i steng nas zhugs pa'i thugs kar hrīḥ'od 'bar ba'o/ /de nas ye shes pa bcug la thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum rigs drug gi snod bcud rnams la phog pas ma dag pa'i dngos po dang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku/ sgra skad thams cad yi ge drug pa'i rang sgra/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te/

thams cad thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams su sangs rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes gdangs dang bcas nas brgya rtsa re bzlas nas/ thams cad dang po'i thugs rje chen po la thim nas/ de yang rang yal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par bzhag nas bsngo ba bya ste/ mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du brdzus te skye ba dang*/ /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab rdzogs te/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /thugs rje'i stobs kyis nub phyogs bde ldan du/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed kyi zhabs drung du/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru+u la/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis zag med brdzus skyes te/ rje btsun khyed dang thugs rje mnyam par shog /ces smon lam gdab bo/ /'dis ni dad pa dang nges 'byung skye zhing las kyi sgrib pa dang nyams chag dag nas lam gyi bogs 'byin/ log 'tsho dang dkor zas kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag sbyong bas shin tu zab bo/ /yid ches shing brtson na 'di gcig pus kyang sangs rgyas 'grub bo/ / de nas nang gi chos spyod bya ba/ rig pa khyad par can gyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ khrus dang na bza' 'bul ba la sogs pa sngon du byas te/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ phyag dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ smon lam dang bcas pa rnams dbyangs snyan pos mgrin gcig tu bya ba ni/ hoḥchos dbyings rnam dag lhun grub chen po nas/ dpag yas thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gyed pa'i lha/ /kun bzang rigs lnga rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bcas/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/

/gdod nas byang chub rdo rje snying po'i gdung*/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos dam chos rin chen mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /da lta mngon bzhugs bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'od bdud rtsi'i chus/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs la khrus gsol zhing*/ /na bza' rin chen rgyan mchog 'di phul bas/ /'gro kun skyon bral yon tan rdzogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya bi sho dha na ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra wā s+t+ra a laṃ kā ra swāhā/ snang srid rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing khams 'dir/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di phul bas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+bhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ mngon par byang chub chos skur dag pa las/ mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /'gal 'khrul nyams chag dus 'dir bskang gyur cig /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa kra rat+na pū dza me gha samu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ sid+dhi pha la hoḥ de nas sku gsum gyi zhing khams so sor gsal gdab la/ maṇ+ḍal dang po la tshom bu bco lnga/ bar pa la dgu /tha ma la lnga bkod la rim pas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbang chen gser gyis gzhi/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/

g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ gter gyi bum pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod yon/ shin tu mdzes pa'i lha mo/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho legs par bkod de/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga gang chen mtsho'i sku dang gsung dang thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i zhing khams 'byams klas pa tshangs chen gyi bskal pa chen pos legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs te 'bul lo/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snying ri rab gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams/ /lha dang mi yi 'dod yon phun tshogs bde gshegs mchod pa'i sprin phung can/ tshangs chen bskal pas legs par brgyan te dge legs rgya mtsho'i bsod nams zhing*/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'di phul bas/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'og min gyi gnas rnam dag stug po bkod bde ba'i zhing khams thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa zhing khams na/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa la/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i ri dwags/ lha'i gos/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/
