yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba/ rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog / rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu nor bu sna tshogs kyi drwa phyed/ rdo karma shir+ṣa'i mda' yab/ rin po che'i drwa mig /seng ma'i pu shu/ rab tu mtho ba'i phyur bu/ 'dod yon gyi snam bur sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ zhal zas ma/ sil snyan ma/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyi nang kun tu yang legs par bkod pa'i gnas/ tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing khams chen po/ ye shes rin po che'i sprin gyi drwa bas legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid/ /bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul lo/ /bde chen gnas ni shin tu mtha' yas bkod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer can/ /sgo bzhi grub bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan ye shes rnam lnga'i rtsig pas brgyan/ sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od 'phro ba/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ 'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang*/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla bre can/ /nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te phul ba yis/ / lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos nyid 'od gsal ba'i zhing khams gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid rnam par dag cing*/ nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa/ nyi zla ltar bkra zhing lhun gyis grub pas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang du yang ma phye mi 'byed 'byed pa med pa'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang 'gro ba drug gi rnam par 'phrul pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i gnas chen po/

lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs/ / sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i klong*/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gzhon nu bum pa sku'i zhing khams/ phyi dang nang med par kun tu'ang nang du gyur pa/ sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ ljang gu'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba chen pos legs par brgyan pa'i bkod pa tshad med pa'i mnga' thang chen por dbang 'byor pa/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa 'di nyid/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ dgongs klong rnam par dag pa'i ngang du ye shes kyi mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal zhing ni ma skyes lhun rdzogs 'dus ma byas/ sna tshogs mi dmigs spros kun nyer zhi ye shes lnga yi gzhal yas khang*/ sku gsum mdzad pa'i 'od zer dang bcas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'od gsal lhun grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing*/ /sku dang thig les ye nas brgyan pa ni/ /rang snang dag pas legs par phul ba yis/ /kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /ces tshigs bcad thung ba rnams gsum gsum du brjod do/ /de nas phyag dang bshags pa la sogs pa ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rol pa/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje ldan pa/ khams gsum gyi chos rje/ dpal mgon rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/

/gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /mkhyen rab ye shes rgya mcho brnyes/ /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang*/ /'od gsal ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /yid bzhin rin chen gtor mnga' ba/ /zhi khro rab 'byams la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur kun 'gro ye shes bdag /bde chen chos nyid mi g.yo ba/ /bla med yid bzhin rin chen gter/ /rdo rje 'chang chen la phyag 'tshal/ /'od gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i lha/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug 'gro ba'i yab/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam grol ye shes rgya mtsho brnyes/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa/ /dga' rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bla med grub pa'i mchog brnyes shing*/ /gsung rab yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ /'gro la chos kyi char 'bebs pa/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse brtson pa'i nam mkha' la/ /ye shes nyi ma'i 'od brdal bas/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /shrī sidha la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /phan bde'i ye shes 'od 'phro bas/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang snang mdzad pa/ /dzñā na sū tra la phyag 'tshal/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong bla med kyis/ /gsung rab pad+mo'i kha 'byed cing*/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bi ma mi tra la phyag 'tshal/ /rang byung pad+ma'i sdong po las/ /nyi shar sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /sa mchog dkyil 'khor chen po brnyes/ /mkhyen brtse'i brtson pa dpag yas shing*/ /rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro kun skyong*/ /chos rgyal chen po la phyag 'tshal/

/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter gyur 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /ting 'dzin bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /zab mo'i dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*/ /bar dor 'od gsal snying po brnyes/ /brtse chen thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag /ldan ma lhun rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ / rnam grol brtson pa'i stobs chen gyis/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi brnyes/ / 'od skur yon tan rdzogs pa yi/ /seng ge dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyong zhing*/ /rtag tu zab mo'i 'od gsal dang*/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub rdzogs par bzhugs/ /rgyal ba zhang ston la phyag 'tshal/ /sa chen gzungs sprin snying po can/ /rnam grol ye shes mchog rab brnyes/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /mkhas pa nyi 'bum la phyag 'tshal/ /bla med tshogs che rab rdzogs shing*/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs/ /nges don snying po don ston pa/ /gu ru jo 'ber la phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul brnyes shing*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing bgrod pa/ /seng ge rgyab pa la phyag 'tshal/ /chos nyid bden pa rab gzigs pa/ /ye shes rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /dpag med 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /grub chen me long la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag 'od gsal snying po'i zhing*/ /rtag tu rang bzhin lhun grub cing*/ /mngon shes gzungs sprin yid bzhin gter/ /ku mā rā dza la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur rtogs pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ /thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas dang*/ /bya bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs ral grol la phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab gzigs shing*/ /dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pas/ / zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa/ /dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ / ngo bo brjod 'di nam mkha'i dang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun yongs la khyab/

/skyabs mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying po'i klong du ye nas grol/ /gsal snang zhing khams chen por rgyas/ /thams cad mnyam sbyor nam mkha'i ngang*/ /dpe bral khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye nas kun bzang rol pa'i ngang*/ khyed ni rtag tu mnyam bzhag kyang*/ /nor bu ji bzhin gzhan don mdzad/ /yid bzhin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes kyis/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /gdong ma'i dbyings su khrid mdzad pa/ /ded dpon khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor bar mgon med rab 'khyams shing*/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i klod yangs nas/ /sgrol bar mdzad pa'i gru bo che/ /brtse chen khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor 'dir/ /yun ring srid par dub pa la/ /spang gnyen rang grol mngon sum lam/ /ston mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig mthong bas rab dad cing*/ /thos pas the tshom drwa ba gcod/ /reg pas byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung*/ /mtshungs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig khyed sku mthong ba dang*/ khyod gsung thos dang 'dzin pa yi/ /'gro ba de dag kun la yang*/ /rtag tu bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /dkyil 'khor lhun grub byang chub sems/ /chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs mchog la/ /rab dwangs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog /ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor 'das kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla med 'od gsal snying po mchog /bde gshegs snying po'i khams mchog la/ /ngo mtshar chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar ba'i lam du zhugs rnams dang*/ /dkon mchog sgra yang thos so 'tshal/ /sems can kun gyi rigs kun la/ /rnam grol slad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun/ /ye nas kun bzang rol pa'i ngang*/ /gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pas/

/ gnyis med ngang du phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol/ / thabs dang shes rab pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun grub pas/ /bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag /kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed mdzad ma/ /rigs kyi yum gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes dbang po dag pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi sras mchog ste/ / sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar can/ /mkha' mnyam mchod pas rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod/ /byang chub sems ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdug pa me tog mar me dri chab ma/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod 'bul ma/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad cing*/ /tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par bsrungs/ /ta kṛta sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ / steng 'og phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso/ /nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyud drug dag par spyod/ /bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag chad mthar phyin gsang ba yum gyi dang*/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma/ sgo ma chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro/ /mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ bcom ldan rang rig thabs kyi rgyal po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi dpal khro bo'i rje/

/che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yum chen rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings gnas pa/ /dpal 'phar kro dhī rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ khro mo gnam zhal ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed rnga pa'i dus nas mngon byung bas/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ / dpal chen he ru ka rnams la phyag 'tshal/ khro mo dbyings phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing*/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba sbyin 'phro ma/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms khro rgyal tshogs su sprul/ /bdud 'dul khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo gcod ye shes bzhi yi ngang*/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis 'gugs 'chid sdom zhing bsdigs/ /sgo bzhi'i las mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bar ba'i gar dgur 'jigs pa'i skur ston zhing*/ /phrin las sna tshogs thabs ldan khro bo'i rje/ /che mchog nyi shu bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ bcom ldan 'jigs byed khrag 'thung he ru ka /krodhī shwa ri thugs rje dbyings kyi yum/ /gtum rngams yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro gtum 'jigs byed kun sgrol he ru ka /dregs pa ru dra 'dul ba'i thabs mnga' ba/ khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro mo dbang phyug krodhī yum chen bzhi/ khro rgyal sku la gnyis med dgyes skong ma/ khrag 'thung yum chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil ni/ /ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed rgyan gyis brgyan/ khro mo chen mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*/ /'dod rgur sgyur ba gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /phra men chen mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi/ /shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par bsrungs/ /sgo skyong khro mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod chas ldan ru dra gdug pa 'dul/

/nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ye shes dpal gyi thugs/ /yang dag sum cu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ thugs rje chen po'i dbyings nas skur sprul pa/ /dag pa'i ngang las bdud 'dul sprul pa'i yum/ /gshin rje yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas mi dmigs chos skur dag pa las/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa/ khro mchog gshed chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug ba 'dul phyir khro bo'i sku la sbyor/ /sbyor sgrol yum gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid spros bral zhi ba chen po las/ / bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur ston pa/ /phyogs skyong gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings ngang las sku bskyed yum gyi tshul/ /gshin rje sku la so sor dgyes par 'khril/ /phyogs skyong yum gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs nyid mi rtog yang dag ye shes kyi/ /'khor ba 'dzin dang mi stong dbyings su sgrol/ /gshin rje'i sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur sprul nas/ /'gro don mdzad phyir gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul/ /gshin rje sum cu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ dbang chen kun 'dus rta mgrin dbang gis sku/ /shes rab gzi ldan e ka dzā ṭi ma/ /dbang sdud sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das dbang sdud phyir/ /gzil gnon drag pos dbang sdud zil gyis gnon/ / zil gnon khro bo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab sems ma yum gyi gzhal yas 'dir/ /rang byung ye shes thugs kyis dbang bskur ba/ /zil gnon khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs ldan 'phrul gyi phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro drug gnas nas 'dren pa'i don mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum 'jig rten dbang du sdud par byed/ /shes rab rang byung ye shes gsung sprul ma/

/gsung mchog nyi shu bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med byang chub sems/ / phyogs bcu'i khro bo kun gyi 'byung gnas yum/ /dpal chen yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrin las rnam bzhis dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad pa/ / ye shes phur bas thams cad dbyings su 'bebs/ /sras mchog rigs bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /phyogs bcu khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen dbyings nas khro mo'i tshogs su bstan/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa lam bskyed rdzogs sbyor/ /ye shes khro mo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bar ba'i pho nya mche gshog sprul ba'i tshogs/ /ci bgyis bka' nyan yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs/ /za byed pha bcu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bzad rngams pa'i za byed mgyogs ma'i tshogs/ /thugs kyi sprul pa phyag rgya sna tshogs ston/ /gsod byed ma bcu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / snying rje ma bral las byed rdzu 'phrul can/ /thogs med kun tu rgyu ba'i pho nyar ston/ /sgo bzhi las mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gtum rngams drag pos dgra bgegs bdud dpung 'joms/ /phur pa lnga bcu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ che btsan 'jigs byed chen po a la la/ /snang srid thams cad yum gyi bha ga'i klong*/ / bla med yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings yum gyi ngang las skur sprul pa/ /pha rol phyin drug ye shes drug gi ngang*/ /dbyings kyi yum drug tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho dpag gis mi longs kyang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis ji ltar 'dul mdzad pa/ /rje mo bcu bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sna tshogs skur ston cing*/ / zhing chen gsar rnying tshogs la longs spyod pa/ /srid pa ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dus las mi 'da' bka' yi las byed cing*/ /phyogs bcu'i dregs pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /srin mo sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung ba lnga nyid ye shes rnam lngar ngag /chos dbyings skyed med ngang las sna tshogs sprul/ /ma mo lnga bcu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ /so so'i sgrub mchog yi dam rtags 'chang ba/ / sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun grub phyag rgya che dang tshe la dbang*/ /so so'i rig 'dzin rigs kyi phyag rgya bsnams/ /rigs kyi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig 'dzin pa la gnyis med lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa yon tan 'byung ba'i gtso/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes/ /rig 'dzin bcu drug tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ dmigs med thabs kyis sna tshogs skur ston pa/ / sku mdog phyag mtshan cir yang sprul zhing bsgyur/ /'jig rten bstan srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes las las grub pa'i dregs pa can/ /dam tshig dbang gis bka' yi bstan pa bsrungs/ /sngags bdag dam can tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ chos nyid ngang las sku sprul khro bo rje/ khro gtum gdug pa 'dul bar sku bzhengs pa/ /mchod bstod dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul drag po'i phrin las mdzad/ /'jig rten las las grub pa'i dregs pa 'joms/ /sngags bdag stobs ldan tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsgrubs pa yis/ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pa/ /sku dang ye shes tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi 'khor tshogs ma mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun kyang dus la mi 'da' dam tshig can/ /rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs nyes stongs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing*/

/bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub ba'i grogs mdzad ma/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ /zhes so/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung*/ /ji bzhin ma spyad slob dpon smad/ /gsang sngags dam tshigs nyams pa'i skyon/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag kun/ /mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i dam blangs nas/ /sku gsung thugs dang yan lag gi / spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga/ /mi spang ba yi dam tshig lnga/ /dang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga/ /shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dam tshig nyams la sogs/ /mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags/ /pha ma rdo rje lcam dral dang*/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /mtshams med lnga yi las byas kun/ /mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags/ /nya stong tshes brgyad dus drug mchod par chag /bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin ma gsal lta ba log /phung dang gtsang sbra ma byas kha tshar shor/ /le lo bsog 'jog bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /de ltar mthol bshags gnong 'gyod kyis/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag dang*/ /nyams sgrib thams cad bskang gyur cig /de lta bu yi 'gyod tshangs kyis/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can gyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgrib byang nas/ /na raka gnas nas dong sbrugs te/ 'gro drug gnas nas thar gyur cig /gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di/ /bka' btsan byin che dar gyur cig /gsang sngags 'di sgrogs rgyal khams su/ /mi nad phyugs nad zhi gyur cig /mi dar lo phyugs legs gyur cig /dge dngos kun gyis spyod gyur cig /rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /skyo ngal med pa'i mtsho rgyal la/ /nyung bsdus man ngag zab mo 'di/ /rgyun du yi dam nar mar gyis/ /zhes gsungs bshags pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi spyi khrus yin/ /nang ka gnas nas dong sbrugs na/

/gsang sngags 'chang bas nyams su longs/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /chos byed rnams kyi nyams chag dang*/ /sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched du mdzad/ /'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i kha skong*/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /jo mo mkhar chen gza' la gdams pa rdzogs so// // oṃ/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*/ /thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ / brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa yi/ /zhi khro sbrul pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ / kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya chen yongs bkod do/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa'i/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas gdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzungs chen bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mor 'khyil pa la/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*/ /ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum bcu/

/byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dag /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin ma tshig rjes gcod ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dbang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bla med go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i so so'i 'dul khrims dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' ka dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyir nos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal/ /yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi 'gyid la/ /don las gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*/ /gdod bya longs yong snyam pa'i le lo yis/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*/ /shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te/ /sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig las/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis ni/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ /skad cig tsam yang phrad par mi bya zhes/ /bka' las byung yang de ltar ma rtogs te/ /gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang*/ /mngon shes chung bas skyon can ma rtogs te/ /nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyes pa bskang ba dang*/ /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*/ /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs/ /nyams dang 'grogs shi nyams pa de dag gis/ /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib pa rnams/ /rang gnod 'gyod pa sems kyis mthol lo

bshags/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med dbyings nas mi 'gyur bdag bkod de/ mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /don dam dmigs med spros dang bral ba la/ /rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na/ /nongs pa mchis na rang gnong bzod par gsol/ /hūm̐/ ye shes lha dang mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/ / phyi nanga'akhor 'das ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral dang*/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnams kyang dgongs su gsol/ /bkod pa'i rgyal po dam tshig 'bum sde las/ /yo ga rnam pa bzhi yi don ched du/ /mkhyen rab mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad mdor bsdus grangs mang po/ / rtogs nas bsrung zhing bsgrub par dam bcas pa'i/ /tshul la gzhung bzhin bsnyen sgrub rngo ma thogs/ /ma rig dbang gis lus dang ngag sems kyis/ / bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rang 'dod rang bskang srung mtshams 'das pa dang*/ /ma rtogs mi bsrungs sgrub pa'i rtsal chung ste/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams pa'i dam tshig las/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag mchis pa mthol lo bshags/ /rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral la/ /log lta ngan sems rku 'phrog brdeg la sogs/ /ngan du smras shing dngos su gnod pa bgyis/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsang bcu la sogs man ngag gnyer gtad pa/ /spyir gsang bzhi dang bar gsang bzhi la sogs/ /dam tshig nyams dang dam 'dres dam med la/ /tshig tu 'dzag cing spyod lam rtsings pa yis/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin g.yel gyir te/

/phyag rgya rnam lnga gzhung bzhin ma gsal bas/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod snying po'i bar chad pa/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga la/ / sbyor sgrol ma byin len dang brdzun du smra/ /tshig brlang la sogs dam tshig rnam lnga ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i ngang du mnyam sbyar nas/ /'gro ba'i don du gzhung bzhin spyad rgyu la/ /bka' dang gzhung bzhin spyad par ma gyur te/ /ma rig log par rtog pa'i nyes byas kyis/ /sbyang bya'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /mi spang ba yi dam tshig rnam lnga la/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*/ /phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs rnam lnga ni/ /ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ /gsang nas bsrung zhing bsgrub par dam bcas te/ /gsang sngags bsgrub gzhi rigs kyi khyad par du/ /rtogs nas spang du med par gnas rgyu la/ /de bzhin ma rtogs nyon mongs rang gar spyad/ /mi spang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /dad du blang ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga la/ /dri chen dri chu dmar cha zil pa dang*/ /māṃ sa la sogs dam rdzas rnam lnga ni/ /grub pa bzhi dang yin pa gsum la sogs/ /so so'i rnam par rtog pa kun sbyong zhing*/ /dngos grub thob par byed pa'i thabs chen po/ /rtog med tshul gyis dang du blang rgyu la/ /gnyis med lta ba nyams su ma len te/ /gtsang smer bltas nas tshul bzhin ma spyad pa/ /bsten bya'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /shes par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga la/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /kha dog lnga dang yul lnga dbang po lnga/ /rnam shes lnga dang rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ /lta ba dman pas de ltar ma rtogs te/ /nyan thos la sogs theg pa 'og ma las/ /rtogs pa khyad par 'phags par ma gyur pas/ /shes bya'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam lnga la/ /rdo rje rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/

/rin chen rigs dang de bzhin pad+ma'i rigs/ / las kyi rigs la sogs te sangs rgyas lnga/ /'di ni bsgrub par bya ba'i 'bras bu ste/ /sgom sgrub ting 'dzin le lo med pa yis/ /rigs lnga'i 'bras bu thob par bgyid rgyu la/ /'bad pa'i rtsal chung sgom sgrub yun thung bas/ / bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu da dung ma thob ste/ /bsgrub bya'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /de la sogs te dam tshig chen po yi/ /gzhung dang 'gal bar gyur pa'i nyes byas kyis/ /ye shes lha dang srung ma dam tshig can/ /ma sring rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod do bzod par gsol/ /rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral dang*/ /rnal 'byor dam can thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dam las 'gal gyur 'gyod do bzod par gsol/ /bdag gis rtse gcig zol zog med pa yi/ /g.yo med sems kyis bshags pa 'di gsol bas/ /bdag gi nyams chag sdig pa kun byang nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sa thob ste/ /byin rlabs gzi byin rtsal 'phags nus mthur ldan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /bdag cag gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig chen po ma nos pa las/ dgongs spyod rgya mtsho gdeng du ma gyur cing sdig pa'i grogs po bsten pa dang las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rdo rje slob dpon la smad pa dang*/ / dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa dang*/ /mched dang lcam dral la lta ba log pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa bgyis pa dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga la rang gar spyod pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkar po la 'bags pa dang*/ tshogs dang mchod pa'i yo byad la rang gar spyad pa dang*/ mchod pa lo zla las 'gyangs pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo dus las yol ba dang*/

lta sgom phyin ci log tu gyur pa dang*/ gsang ba mngon du phyungs pa dang*/ snod ma yin pa la chos bshad pa dang*/ bskang bar mi 'os pa'i nyams pa bskang ba dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ tshogs 'dres pa dang*/ tshogs byin gyis ma brlabs par spyad pa dang*/ tshogs kyi spyang ki bgyis pa dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs kyi don las g.yel ba la sogs pa/ 'di dang phyi ma'i las kyi sgrib par gyur pa/ sku'i dam tshig nyams pa/ gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang gcod cing bsdam par bgyid lags so/ /de nas don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' ma rtogs pa rnams la 'gyod pa skyes nas ston pa kun tu bzang po'i spyan sngar 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos kyi dbyings ni spros dang bral ba la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba thang re chad/ /dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /spros med bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi/ /kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la/ /gtsang dang sme bar lta ba thang re chad/ bzang dang ngan par 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /kun bzang bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi/ /nyams pa nyid la che chung med pa la/ / bdag dang gzhan du lta ba thang re chad/ /che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni skye 'chi med pa la/ /'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad/ /skye 'chi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /skye 'chi med pa'i g.yung drung klong du bshags/ / theg le chen po grwa zur med pa la/ /gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba thang re chad/ / grwa zur dbyibs su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /kun nas zlum pa'i thig le'i klong du bshags/ /dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /thog ma tha mar lta ba thang re chad/ /snga phyi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/

/dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong du bshags/ /rang byung ye shes btsal du med pa la/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur lta ba thang re chad/ /rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /rtsol ba med pa'i rang byung klong du bshags/ /rgyu rkyen med pa'i rang rig ye shes la/ /ye shes yod med lta ba thang re chad/ / rtag chad gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /skye 'gag med pa'i rang rig klong du bshags/ /chos dbyings rnam dag mtha' dbus med pa la/ /phyogs dang ris su lta ba thang re chad/ /mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /rnam dag mtha' dbus med pa'i klong du bshags/ /gzhal yas khang nyid yangs dogs med pa la/ /phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad/ /yangs dogs gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /phyi nang yangs dogs med pa'i klong du bshags/ /yum gyi mkha' nyid mtho dman med pa la/ /steng dang 'og tu lta ba thang re chad/ /mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /bha ga mtho dman med pa'i klong du bshags/ /chos kyi sku ni gnyis su med pa la/ / yul dang sems su lta ba thang re chad/ /snod dang bcud du 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes klong du bshags/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i blo 'di snying re rje/ /dngos med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin/ /gang zag 'khrul pa'i blo ni yongs re sdug /skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu 'dzin/ /snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes pas/ /zang zing nor la chags pa'i sems ni skyes/ /'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes nas/ /gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par 'dzin/ /mi shes skye bo'i sems ni yongs re gol/ /bden pa'i don bor 'khor ba'i las la brtson/ /ston pa'i bka' bor 'jig rten g.yeng bas bslus/ /rang rig don bor 'khor ba'i las la brtson/ /'di 'dra'i don med sems can snying re rje/ /dbye ba med pa'i klong du+u bshags par bgyi/ /zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod pa'i rjes la/

langs nas/ dngos dang yid las byung ba yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pas/ /mchod 'os kun la mchod par bgyi/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i mchod chen po/ / mkha' mnyam dri ma med pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab mchod cing*/ /dgyes mnyam byang chub che mchog mchod/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ / dge ba kun dang dngos kun gyis/ /'gro kun yongs mchod sems can kun/ /yongs grol ye shes mchod pas mchod/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnas kyi bar/ /bdag gi yid bzhin mchod sprin gyis/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i mchod sprin shog /lus dang ngag yid sgrib pa kun/ /mchod 'os kun gyi spyan sngar bshags/ /slan chad rab tu 'gyod sems kyis/ /srog gi slad du'ang mi bgyid do/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /gsang ba gsum dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thams cad ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /shes dang mi spang dang du blang*/ /sgrub dang spyad pa lnga lnga ste/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag kun/ /gnod 'gyod chen pos so sor bshags/ /bdag ni mi mkhas gti mug pas/ /'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur te/ /thar pa'i sgrib par gyur to 'tshal/ /thams cad bshags kyis dag gyur cig /mkha' mnyam yangs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /spang blang med pa'i byang chub sems/ /chos nyid dbyings su rdzogs gyur cig /rgyal ba kun dang sems can gyi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo*/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa bzhin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mchog kun la/ /ma lus sems can gnas kyi bar/ /rnam grol mdzad par gsol ba 'debs/

/sku tshe lhun po ltar brtan zhing*/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar bzhugs nas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /srid nas zhi bar drang du gsol/ /las dang nyon mongs rgya mtsho 'dir/ /dbang med dbyings pa'i 'gro ba kun/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i gru chen gyis/ /yongs su sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ /ma rig mun pa'i tshogs chen po/ /ye shes zer gyis sol mdzod la/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung me tshogs kyis/ /yongs su gdungs pa zhi bar mdzod/ /mgon med srid pa'i sems can gyi/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor kun gyi gzhi/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis shing rta yi/ /'phang lo 'dra ba gzhig tu gsol/ /tshul min yid byed kyis sprul pa'i/ /spros pa'i 'khor lo gzhom pa dang*/ /don med 'jig rten bya ba las/ /bdag gi yid ni bzlog tu gsol/ /nyin dang mtshan mo dus kun tu/ /sdig sems yid la mi 'byung zhing*/ /thar pa'i dge la rab brtson nas/ /byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba kun la mchod pa dang*/ /dpal mgon bla ma mnyes byed cing*/ /zab mo'i dam chos 'dzin par shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /thos bsam sgrub pa lhur len cing*/ nor bdun yon tan phun tshogs te/ /rtag tu gzhan la phan par shog /bdag ni deng nas dus kun tu/ /'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur te/ /mthong thos dran reg gyur pa kun/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /'ga' zhig khro'am smod gyur tam/ kha zer skur pa 'debs kyang rung*/ /de yang byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ /bdag gi gdul bya'i thog mar shog /gang zhig dad pas bstod gyur tam/ /mos pas rjes su dran yang rung*/ /dngos grub rin chen mdzod brnyes nas/ /mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob par shog /bdag la brten nas gzhan dag gi /nyes kun zad pa'i gzhir gyur te/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin gyur nas/ /dge ba 'ba' zhig 'phel par shog

/bdag gi ming tsam grags pas kyang*/ /sems can kun gyi skyabs byed cing*/ /gos dang skra sen tsam gyis kyang*/ /yongs su bsrungs pa chen por shog /gang gis rjes su dran tsam gyis/ /chom rkun la sogs 'jigs med cing*/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /skad cig nyid la 'grub par shog /bdag ni deng nas phyi ma'i mthar/ /sems can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs/ /dpung gnyen byed pa nyid gyur te/ /re ba thams cad bskang bar shog /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyid gyur nas/ /dbul phongs thams cad sel byed cing*/ /bsam rgu'i re ba bskang bar shog /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dge ba kun gyis thun mong du/ /yongs su sbyang ba'i gzhir gyur te/ /gzhan don phan pa mtha' yas shog /bdag gis brtsams pa thams cad kun/ /sems can kun gyi don gyur te/ /dpag med dka' ba bzod pa dang*/ /gnod lan phan pa 'grub par shog /sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /bdag gi brtson pas don byed cing*/ /thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral nas/ /bdag gis byang chub thob par shog /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam/ /snang ba bzhi po mthar phyin nas/ /'pho ba chen po'i lus bzung ste/ /gzhan don mtha' yas spyod par shog /bdag la brten pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'di nyid dam bar do'am/ /phyi mar sprul sku'i zhing bgrod de/ /thams cad gdong mar grol bar shog / bdag gi brtson pa thams cad kyis/ /sems can gcig tsam ma lus par/ / srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab brgal nas/ /phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ / ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /rgyal khams kun tu dar rgyas shog /ces dag cing gdangs snyan pos bya'o/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las dgong thun gyi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas srod kyi rnal 'byor ni/ sngar bzhin bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/

rdzogs pa chen po'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa la 'bang cing*/ khyad par du bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang stong pa'i ngang las/ sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i bla ma'i sku las ram̐ 'phros pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad me'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'khor bas sde brgyad thams cad dum bur gtub cing bsregs/ phyi nang me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par che ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug gi bla ma rang gi snying nang du spyan drangs la bsgom mo/ /'dis ni bgegs dang bar du gcod ba thams cad srung ba'i mchog yin pas shin tu gal

che'o/ / chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las/ /srod kyi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ / de nas nam gung gi rnal 'byor ni/ dang po sā la'i tshogs 'khor ni/ rang nyid tha mal pa'i snying nang nas/ rang rig rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa tshangs bu nas thon nas/ gri gug gis rang githod pa smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas bcad do/ /thod pa'i skyed bu ri rab tsam gsum gyi steng du bzhag pa'i nang du rang gi lus dum bur phral bcug la/ yam̐las rlung byungabs ram̐ las me spar te thod pa'i rdzas khol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ snang srid kyi bdud rtsi bsam pas thod par 'dres te 'dod yon lnga'i phung por gyur/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi mgron thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gror gyur te/ steng gi nam mkhar byon nas bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro gcig las mkha' 'gro bye ba mang po 'phros te/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas thod pas gcus te/ mgron rnams la phul bas dgyes shi gsol bas/ mthar de rnams kyi thugs ka nas dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi byung bas thod pa gang ba la rang gis rol bas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ slar mchod mgron rnams mnyes pa'i nganganas/ /rdzas dang bdag dang mgron rnams bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ /bla ma yang rang yal te stong pa'i ngang la dar cig klod la bzhag go /'dis ni nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ nyams chag bskang ba dang*/ 'chi khar gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal med par/ 'chi ba bslu bas tshe'i rim gror 'gyur pa la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med do/ / mjug tu smon lam gdab pa ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis thog ma med dang da lta'i bar/ /dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba des/ /bdag gzhan ma lus byang chub thob par shog

/de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /lam zab rdzogs chen snying po'i don rtogs nas/ /chos nyid mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs nas/ /zag bcas phung po 'od skur grol bar shog / gnad gcod drag po'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mig gi dbang por mngon sum byon nas ni/ /dbang bskur lung bstan mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /'dus byas mi rtag 'chi ba byung tsa na/ /'gyu ba'i rlung chad bems rig bral ba'i tshe/ /zhen chags 'khrul pa'i snang ba mi 'char bar/ /gnas lugs chos sku'i ngang la gnas par shog /sgyu lus gdos bcas 'jog pa'i dus babs na/ /snang phung phra rag rtog pa 'gag pa'i tshe/ /'khrul med khyab gdal gdod ma'i dbyings chen la/ /bems rig bral ma thag tu grol bar shog /ma dag 'byung bzhi'i dngos po dengs pa'i tshe/ /dag pa'i 'od lnga ma 'dres 'od gsal dang*/ /rtog med 'od lnga'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /dbyer med gcig 'dres chos zad mthar phyin shog /hūm̐ chen khros pa srin po'i gzugs can sogs/ /hūm̐ sgras stong gsum ma lus gang tsa nam /rig stong hūm̐ sgra'i gnad du ngo shes nas/ /grags stong brag cha lta bur rtogs par shog /gshin rje'i dmag mi'i tshogs kyis bskor tsa na/ /rgyob sod 'bros 'ded 'khrul pa dbyings dag nas/ /bred sngangs 'khrul pa'i snang ba mi 'char bar/ /yi dam zhi khro'i sku ru mthong bar shog /dung khang 'bar ba'i bde chen gzhal yas nas/ khro bo'i tshogs rnams gnas nas gyes pa'i tshe/ /'jigs gzugs srin po'i sku ru mi 'char bar/ / man ngag snying tig dgongs pa'i don rtogs shog /tsit+ta rin chen gur khang gzhal yas nas/ /zhi ba'i tshogs rnams dbyings su yal ba'i tshe/ /snang ba ru log 'od skur shar ba'i dus/ /rig pa 'od kyi klong du thim par shog /mgrin mgul rtsa yi 'khor lo bral ba'i tshe/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs 'brug stong ldir tsa na/

/āḥhūm̐ zhi khro'i gdangs su ngo shes nas/ /rig stong skye med dbyings su grol bar shog /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas/ /thabs shes dkar dmar snying gar phrad tsam na/ /bde stong zag pa med pa'i gnas lugs des/ /rlung rig dbu ma'i nang du tshud par shog /chos nyid bar do'i ngang du gnas pa'i tshe/ /bems rig lung ma bstan du ma lus par/ /rang grol ka dag chen po'i don rtogs te/ /gzhan stong chos zad ngang la gnas par shog /chos nyid mngon sum bden pa mthong ba'i tshe/ / gnyen po'i dran 'dzin bsgom pa'i blo bral nas/ /ka dag zad sar skyol ba'i don rtogs te/ /rtog med spros bral ngang la gnas par shog /'ja' tshon sna lnga 'dres pa'i gzhal yas na/ /ye shes lnga yi gur khang sgo phye nas/ /sku dang thig les zhing khams gang ba'i tshe/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang mjal bar shog /thig le stong sgron 'od gsal gzhal yas su/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang mjal tsa na/ /snyems byed gnyis snang the tshom med pa ru/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i ngang du thim parashog /sems nyid sgron ma bzhi dang dngos mjal nas/ / thig le stong sgron 'od gsal gzhal yas su/ /lhun grub sbubs la brtan pa mthar phy-in nas/ /dbyings rig nam mkha'i ngang du 'phro bar shog /stong nyid rig pa'i chos sku thob par shog /'gag med gnyis snang longs sku thob par shog /rang rig mthar phyin sprul sku thob par shog /sku gsum thob nas gzhan don byed par shog /ces sogs smon lam rgya cher gdab bo/ /de nas bde ba'i mal du g.yas phab nas nyal ba'i snying nang du bla ma 'od kyi gong bu'i dbus na shin tu cha phra bar bzhugs pa la lus stod smad 'dus nas/ skra rtse tsam gyi bla ma 'od dang bcas pa la sems bzung nas nyal bas gnyid 'od gsal du grol nas rmi lam gyi bag chags sbyong ba'i mchog yin no/ /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa las/ /nam gung gi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/

/ de ltar nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba'i tshul/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzangapos legs par bkod/ /dge pas 'gro kun thar pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /nyin dang mtshan dus chos la spyod par shog /chos spyod lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ grogs ri rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas su sbyar ba legs par rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos spyod lam khyer rim pa/ - PAGE 324- - PAGE 323- -PAGE 276-
